title: 10-Minute Tomato & Egg Skillet
description: A quick, lighter shakshuka-style skillet: fresh tomatoes mashed down with onion and capsicum, eggs poached through.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 265, rated 9.275/10 (Worth the Hype). Original inspiration: @tastyiri_en.

confidence.note: Amounts and method from the creator's caption. Not yet cooked. Spice amounts are to taste in the source.

nutrition.note: As stated by the creator; carbs, fat and fibre given as approximate.

items.item: pepper, paprika, dried oregano and salt

steps.title: Soften
steps.text: Spray the pan and set over medium-low heat. Cook the onion ({{onion}}) and capsicum for 3–4 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Tomatoes
steps.text: Add the whole tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}) and cook for 2 minutes, then peel and mash them in the pan.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir the spices and grated cheese ({{cheese}}) into the simmering tomato.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Add the eggs ({{eggs}}) and egg whites ({{whites}}). Stir gently or let them poach in the sauce until done to your liking.
